# SalesClaw AI

SalesClaw AI is an AI sales agent for B2B teams: it researches prospects from your ICP, writes personalized outreach in your voice, and follows up 24/7 until meetings land in your calendar.

## What it does
- **Prospect research**: ICP → enriched company + decision-maker profiles with intent scoring.
- **Outreach in your voice**: personalized first lines from real signals (hiring, funding, news, tech stack).
- **24/7 follow-up**: multi-touch sequences that adapt to each reply (bump / pivot / book), time-zone aware, spam-safe.
- **Meeting-first routing**: replies classified, interested ones routed to your calendar with full context.
- **Attribution**: revenue by campaign, sequence, persona; CRM-friendly exports (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce).
- **Compliance**: GDPR-first, EU data residency, opt-out in one click, sender-reputation guardrails.

## Pricing
- Solo: 99 EUR/mo (1 seat, 500 prospects/mo)
- Team: 299 EUR/mo (5 seats, 2,500 prospects/mo, CRM sync)
- Scale: custom (unlimited, dedicated EU infra, SOC 2 + DPA)
